tool_args.rationale: The open-branch probe identified the smooth gradient dependence but stopped at s_grad = 2.35. The trajectory batch is the only remaining relevant probe; observations above the recalled 2.50–2.68 activation range would distinguish smooth continuation from an avalanche penalty.

considered_alternatives.option: Confirm the smooth sink-gradient model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It fits all seven rows to rounding precision, but every measured gradient is below the recalled activation range, where the smooth and avalanche models make identical predictions.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the avalanche threshold and strength now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The avalanche term is zero on every paid row for any threshold in the recalled range, so neither parameter is identifiable.
The auxiliary measurement does not test gradient activation.
